methods.label: Ranged Fanatic kill
methods.summary: Range Chaos Fanatic from a distance while dodging explosive green magic attacks.
steps: Fight with ranged because Chaos Fanatic has high magic level and defence.
Move away from the green explosive attack rather than tanking stacked damage.
Keep enough distance and supplies to react to player-killers.
Pick up valuable drops quickly and reset if the area becomes unsafe.
risks: The explosive attack can hit hard if the player does not move.
Wilderness interruptions are a primary risk.

methods.label: Wilderness risk control
methods.summary: Limit carried risk and use fast banking or teleport routes because the boss is in the Wilderness.
requiredOrKeyItems: Royal seed pod or other escape route
steps: Choose gear around acceptable risk instead of maximum theoretical DPS.
Keep protect item available when carrying a valuable weapon.
Leave immediately if a hostile player appears and escape is still possible.
